selected_scale.selection: train-only equal-object CRPS, frozen before old-prefix inference

scope: Six repeatedly inspected development prefixes from two furniture permutations of one floorplan, not held-out geometry or independent scenes.
calibration_boundary: Declared CRPS promotion criterion passed; informative 95% intervals cover 9/12 validation and 8/12 held-out, so nominal probabilistic calibration is NOT established. No retuning after these outcomes.
actor_invariants: Original acquired prefix packets/feedback and before-TSDF must match byte hashes.
Original candidate routes and common coverage/measured-surface scores must remain exactly as sealed.
Every state builds one observed-data particle bank shared by all five arms.
G/S within each fixed/uncertainty mode have identical points, hypothesis/object/particle IDs and scenes; weights can differ.
Mean-collapse has a separate basis derived from the S joint posterior, with no second likelihood update.
All acquired quality fields, memberships, frames, keyframes, belief and native TSDF remain unchanged by predictions.
Inherited B2 trace gain, history, per-sample route maximum, area coefficient1, outbound-only predicted area, and original stops/budget/navigation unchanged.

outputs.arm_files: Each of five arms has complete points, posterior/base/history weights, hypothesis/object/particle/shape IDs, support tracks, named per-candidate gain vectors and the complete candidate-by-point union matrix.
outputs.metadata: Full posterior/conditional geometry/support hashes and B2 trace audits; scale resource and pre/post acquired-evidence hashes.
outputs.actual_outcomes: Exactly the same 66 previously measured branch outcomes; no reexecution and no independent sample multiplication.

evaluation.reference: Frozen B evaluator source triangles and before/after native TSDF, accessed only after predictions by independent evaluator.
metrics: absolute source-supported and realized forecast area
rank association with realized target surface increment
selected actual gross/net surface and unknown coverage increment
action/path cost and all ties/negative effects
evaluation.baseline: B6 AB prediction is an explicit historical reference; G_fixed/S_fixed are new controls, not old O.

failure_accounting: Retain every failed attempt and missing/invalid comparison; never report partial states as complete. No candidate or object deletion to improve a result.
runtime_protection: No hardware/ROS endpoint or actuator in this replay.
